title: A Beach Trip That Changed His Mind
paragraphs: Selalu lebih menyukai kota daripada alam sepanjang hidupnya, Karim dengan enggan setuju melakukan perjalanan pantai yang diatur istrinya, memperkirakan akan menghabiskan sebagian besar akhir pekan bosan dan memeriksa ponselnya. Pada pagi pertama, ia bangun awal dan berjalan di sepanjang pantai hanya karena tidak bisa tidur, tidak menyangka akan menemukan pantai yang sepi dan tenang itu semenenangkan yang ternyata dirasakannya.

Selama dua hari berikutnya, ia mendapati dirinya menyimpan ponselnya lebih lama dari biasanya, benar-benar terserap memperhatikan ombak dan mendengarkan suara air. Dalam perjalanan pulang, Karim mengakui kepada istrinya bahwa ia salah menilai seberapa besar ia membutuhkan ketenangan semacam ini, dan ia mengusulkan merencanakan perjalanan lain lebih cepat dari yang diperkirakan keduanya.
answerKey: Preferring cities to nature his entire life, Karim reluctantly agreed to a beach trip organized by his wife, expecting to spend most of the weekend bored and checking his phone. On the first morning, he woke early and walked along the shore simply because he could not sleep, not expecting to find the quiet, empty beach as calming as it turned out to be. Over the following two days, he found himself putting his phone away for longer stretches than usual, genuinely absorbed in watching the waves and listening to the sound of the water. Driving home, Karim admitted to his wife that he had misjudged how much he needed this kind of quiet, and he suggested planning another trip sooner than either of them had expected.
